name: Ashford Foodbank
short_description: Trussell Trust foodbank serving Ashford and surrounding areas
description: Part of The Trussell Trust network. Provides emergency food parcels and support to local residents in crisis. Open Tuesdays and Fridays.

name: Ashford Community Garden
short_description: Community garden at Repton Park with 30+ plots
months: this garden provides growing space for residents and hosts seasonal harvest festivals. New members welcome.

name: Ashford Food Share Community Fridge
short_description: Community fridge at St Mary's Church reducing food waste
description: Located at St Mary's Church Hall
months: this fridge allows residents to share surplus food and access free items. Open Monday-Saturday mornings.
